text: Reveal all of the Sweet Honey in your hand, and this attack does {n} damage for each card you revealed in this way.
Discard a [G] Energy from this Pokémon.
Look at a random card from your opponent's hand and shuffle it into their deck.
Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Put a rental card into your hand.
Whenever you attach a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone to this Pokémon, do {n} damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
As long as this Pokémon is in play, flip {n} more coins for the Rabbit Jumping attack used by your Pokémon.
Discard {n} [W] Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does {n} damage to {n} of your opponent's Pokémon.
If your opponent has a Stadium in play, discard it.
Once during your turn, when you play this card from your hand to evolve {n} of your Pokémon, you may use this Ability. Put a random Frogadier from your deck onto your Bench.
Once during your turn, you may take a [L] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to the [L] Pokémon in the Active Spot.
Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep. Your opponent flips {n} coins for this Special Condition, and if either of them is tails, that Pokémon is still Asleep.
Flip {n} coins. Take an amount of [P] Energy from your Energy Zone equal to the number of heads and attach it to your Benched [P] Pokémon in any way you like.
This attack does {n} more damage for each [P] Energy attached to this Pokémon.
During your next turn, this Pokémon's Psycho Boost does −{n} damage.
Move all Energy from this Pokémon to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.
Take {n} [F] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
As long as this Pokémon is in play, all of your [M] Pokémon take −{n} damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon. This effect doesn't stack.
Put {n} random [C] Pokémon from your deck into your hand.
Put a random card that evolves from Eevee from your deck into your hand.
Choose {n} of your Pokémon, and then flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, heal {n} damage from that Pokémon.
Heal {n} damage from {n} of your Pokémon that has any Energy attached. If you healed any damage in this way, discard a random Energy from that Pokémon.
Switch out your opponent's Active Stage {n} Pokémon to the Bench. (Your opponent chooses the new Active Pokémon.)
Your Active Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.
The Basic Pokémon this card is attached to takes −{n} damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.
Attacks used by the Pikachu ex this card is attached to do +{n} damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
During this turn, attacks used by your Dewgong, Cloyster, or Lapras do +{n} damage to your opponent's Pokémon.
You can use this card only if you have Venusaur, Charizard, Blastoise, or Pidgeot in play. Switch in {n} of your opponent's Benched Pokémon to the Active Spot.
Look at the top {n} cards of your deck and put {n} of them into your hand. Shuffle back into your deck.
Produce {n} [F] Energy from your Energy Zone, and attach it to {n} of your Whiscash or Paldean Clodsire.
Put {n} random cards from among Super Potion, Max Repel, and Full Heal from your deck into your hand.
You can use this card only if you have {n} or more different Pokémon types in play. Switch your Active Pokémon with {n} of your Benched Pokémon.
Once during each player's turn, that player may use this effect. Flip a coin. If heads, draw a card.
Flip a coin for each [P] Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does {n} damage for each heads.
Move all [P] Energy from {n} of your Benched [P] Pokémon to your Mega Mewtwo Y ex in the Active Spot.
